senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; גבע, ל dimin.; cmp. גָּבִיעַ)calyx or capsule of plants.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 75a:11">Ib. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>זרע פשתן בגבעולין</he> (Ms. M. 2 <he>בגִבְעוֹלָיו</he>) the seed of flax in (its) capsules; v. <cite ref="C00154"><he>גַּד</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:4">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>נעשה ג׳</he> the flax had formed capsules; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18:3">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>ומצאה ג׳</he> (when no longer good for linen).
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 11:7">Par. XI, 7</cite>, v. <cite ref="C01037"><he>גָּמַל</he></cite>; a. fr.
